Partisan managed to eavesdrop on the cultists' conversation before the tripwire killed them. The Harbinger, as they call him, is in charge of this whole terror parade. He promised them that if they did what he told them, they'd receive the new Gift of the Unheard. What the hell? I have no idea what this means. But I'm certain that if you let them perform the damn ritual, there'll be countless victims amongst the decent folk. People have started fleeing the Streets, they say a ghost is hunting for souls. We don't know the details of this mystery, but it's definitely connected to the whole thing! And we know who's behind it. We need to take out the Harbinger, and if you find any creepy crap near him, try to bury it deep in the ground. Maybe that'll keep the cultists in line.}} ==Objectives== * Locate and neutralize the Oni * Locate and neutralize the Harbinger * Locate and neutralize the Ghost ==Rewards== * +40,000 [[EXP]] * [[Jaeger]] Rep '''+0.04''' * 200,000 Roubles ** 210,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1 ** 230,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2 * 1× [[Armasight Zeus-Pro 640 2-8x50 30Hz thermal scope]] * 1× [[SIG Sauer ECHO1 1-2x30mm 30Hz thermal reflex scope]] * 1× [[Abandoned factory marked key]] * 1× [[Mysterious room marked key]] {{quote|The bastards are taken care of?
